name: negate-activation-poised-occlusion
notes: Player 2 attempts to activate Poised Occlusion (w64layznmh) from hand while it is player 1's Main phase with an empty effect stack and no active opportunity/response window. ActionMap() requires either the acting player to be the turn player in MAIN phase, or an active opportunity (HasOpportunity()) for a non-turn-player hand play to go through; neither holds here, so the FSM activation attempt is a true no-op: ActivateCard() is never called, no card leaves hand, no decision is queued, and the gamestate is byte-identical before and after.
